Operating daily in diverse urban environments, RIVR's robots continuously learn from and navigate the millions of scenarios encountered during deliveries. By owning the full stack from software.

By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of […] skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.

Streamline the data collection and training workflow to efficiently expand model capabilities with new tasks and data sources.
Collaborate with the reinforcement learning team to innovate methods that leverage both simulated and real-world data.
Optimize and distill networks for real-time deployment on the edge (e.g. Nvidia Jetson Thor).
Build, lead and mentor an exceptional team of software engineers.

cern:744000156563269.title: ARIA - Literature Review AI Automation (IT-PW-WDA-2026-165-GRAP)
cern:744000156563269.desc:
ARIA/ CAiMIRA is a joint WHO-CERN project that models the airborne transmission of respiratory pathogens and develops an automated, structured, and transparent systematic literature review process to inform public health policy and guidance. It builds on CERN's expertise in data management and knowledge systematisation. The planned second phase will extend the project to other airborne pathogens and to indoor air quality.
 Work Package 4, "NLP Mechanisms for Systematic Literature Reviews," will continue automating the systematic review process and associated data analysis using AI-based […] Your profile: 
 Extensive experience in ML/NLP-based data science.
 Strong expertise in systematic literature review workflows and methodologies.
 Recognised expertise in AI-assisted research tools.
 Proficiency in full-stack development and DevOps practices.
 Hands-on experience deploying applications on Kubernetes/OpenShift.
 Skills: 
 Programming : Advanced proficiency in Python, JavaScript and React.
 UI/UX: Design and development of intuitive, user-centred interfaces.
 Systematic reviews: Strong expertise in systematic literature review workflows and methodologies.
 AI/NLP: In-depth experience designing and deploying AI and NLP pipelines.
 DevOps : Solid working knowledge of DevOps practices, including CI/CD and containerisation.
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 You have a professional background in Data Science (or a related field) and have either: a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
 or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 09.11.2026 at 23:59 CET. 
 Contract duration: 12 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Hybrid

Head motion is the single biggest obstacle to functional MRI in the first years of life: it corrupts the BOLD signal, discards large fractions of hard-won data, and biases what survives. The FreezeMotion project tackles this end to end – from the pulse sequence, through image reconstruction, to deep-learning-based signal recovery – so that the functional signal we care about can be measured reliably in awake infants. Prosjektet undersøker hybride rammeverk hvor GenAI fungerer som semantiske tolkningsmoduler, mens symbolske logikkmoduler — som resonerer over strukturerte grafer eller regler — fungerer som faktasjekkere. linkedin:4482119513.desc: Projektbeskrivning Kemiska föroreningar hotar människors hälsa och ekosystem över hela jorden. Data om kemiska faror är avgörande för att upptäcka och mildra potentiella negativa effekter i ett tidigt skede. På senare tid har beräkningsverktyg, såsom transformers-modeller, använts för att exakt förutsäga bland annat kemisk toxicitet gentemot miljön. Träningen av sådana modeller är beroende av att stora mängder toxicitetsdata extraheras från vetenskapliga publikationer, rapporter och säkerhetsdokument och samlas i öppna databaser, som ECOTOX. Dataextraktion görs för närvarande för hand, oftast […] av myndigheter, vilket inte hinner med den ständigt växande mängden ny forskning. Detta har blivit en stor flaskhals som inte bara hindrar tillämpningen av beräkningsmetoder för riskbedömning, utan i slutändan också begränsar en effektiv lagstiftning för att skydda både människor och miljö. AI-agenter (LLM-agenter) är lovande alternativ som har potential att ta bort denna flaskhals och automatisera arbetsflödet. Eftersom den genererade datan används i sammanhang med höga insatser krävs dock garantier för både noggrannhet och spårbarhet i extraktionsprocessen. Framför allt är ekotoxikologiska studier ökänt svåra att läsa och förstå, vilket kräver att agenterna kan särskilja relevant data från irrelevant data i publikationer som ofta är fyllda med figurer, tabeller, referenser med mera, baserat på kontext. Huvudsakliga uppgifter Vi söker två studenter som ska utveckla och implementera AI-agenter i syfte att extrahera kemisk toxicitetsdata från vetenskaplig litteratur. Med utgångspunkt i tidigare arbete blir målet att vidareutveckla en pipeline som (1) kan ta emot en lista med publikationer som indata och producera strukturerad data, samt (2) sålla bland tidigare publicerad litteratur som ännu inte har utvärderats. Vi kommer att börja med – men inte begränsa oss till – att använda ECOTOX-databasen som referensdatabas, vilken vi siktar på att återskapa och göra en benchmark för. …

People at Apple don't just build products — they craft the kind of experience that has revolutionized entire industries. The diverse collection of our people and their ideas inspire innovation in everything we do.

Practical experience running machine learning models and evaluating them for quality and performance metrics
Familiar with Apple ML stack (ANE, CoreML, MPS/Metal),
High-level general distributed ML stack (PyTorch-distributed, NCCL) and high throughput inter-chip communication systems.
On-device iOS development

ericsson:563121777408469.desc:
Join our Team
 About the opportunity 
Join Ericsson Research and help shape the future of connectivity. AI is central to Ericsson’s 6G vision, enabling intelligent, sustainable, and secure networks for people and industries in the 2030s and beyond. Our work combines machine learning, advanced reasoning, and real network systems, with access to live network data and opportunities to influence global standards and technologies used worldwide. 
This early-career role suits a recent master’s graduate or someone with a few years of experience in AI/ML. You’ll take on meaningful research from day […] Skills you bring 
• An MSc in AI, data science, computer science, engineering physics, robotics, or a closely related field is preferred. Candidates with an MSc and strong AI research experience are also encouraged to apply. 
• A strong foundation in modern AI, such as deep, reinforcement, or distributed learning; generative AI; probabilistic modelling; stochastic optimization; or graph-based methods. 
• Python programming skills and familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow. 
• Some experience designing, training, or validating ML-driven systems through studies, internships, or personal projects. Familiarity with simulation-based evaluation is valuable. 
• Interest in AI coding assistants and openness to new tools. Experience with Docker or Kubernetes is a plus. 
• Interest in telecommunications, networking, or signal processing. Telecom expertise can be learned on the job. 
• A curious, self-directed approach: you generate and test ideas, learn independently, ask questions, seek expert input, and work through uncertainty. You bring analytical problem-solving, ownership, and collaborative skills, and can communicate clearly, including explaining AI concepts to non-specialists.

Du är den som ser till att data faktiskt håller när beslut fattas på den. Cybersecurity: Du arbetar med säkerhet i moln, nätverk eller applikationer, kanske med NIS2, incidenthantering eller säkerhetsarkitektur. Du tänker som en angripare och bygger som en försvarare. Vi söker talanger i både Stockholm & Umeå, där hybrid tjänst är möjligt för vissa uppdrag. Vem är du? Du har flera års erfarenhet inom något av områdena ovan och vet vad det innebär när saker måste fungera i produktion. Du är trygg i din kompetens och vill använda den till något större än nästa leverans. Du behöver inte ha drivit eget tidigare. linkedin:4444597449.desc: Het modereren van Nederlandstalige gebruikersinhoud is uitdagend door taalvarianten, samenstellingen en dialecten. In deze opdracht onderzoek je hoe een lokale oplossing deze uitdaging kan aanpakken zonder afhankelijk te zijn van externe AI-diensten. Wie vandaag in Vlaanderen een app bouwt met user-generated content, moet kiezen tussen twee gebrekkige opties: een eenvoudig woordenboekfilter dat struikelt over de Nederlandse morfologie (samenstellingen zoals ‘prijsklasse’ worden geblokkeerd op “ass”, eigennamen als “Kontich” op “kont”), of een dure, trage buitenlandse AI-API die je […] ta naar externe diensten stuurt en Vlaams dialect beperkt ondersteunt. Er bestaat waardevol Vlaams onderzoek naar Nederlandstalige moderatie (RobBERT, BERTje, het werk van de CLiPS-groep aan UAntwerpen), maar dat is nooit verpakt als een praktische, installeerbare tool voor developers. perplexity:3938a587-e8ba-4cdf-a811-1f580.desc:
About the role

Perplexity's fraud prevention team protects our products, users, and infrastructure from fraud and abuse across the whole lifecycle: sign-up, authentication, payments, API usage, and product features. We build and operate a real-time decisioning platform together with the surrounding systems: data pipelines for detection and model training, integrations with product and payment systems, and internal tooling for investigation and response. As a software engineer on the team, you will own services end to end, from design to production operations, and work closely with fraud analysts, ML engineers, and product teams to make abuse expensive and legitimate usage frictionless.


Responsibilities

 - Design, build, and operate high-throughput, low-latency backend services for fraud detection and prevention

 - Build data pipelines and real-time feature computation that power detections and ML models

 - Collect and process trust signals

 - Integrate fraud decisions into product, auth, and payment flows across Perplexity

 - Own reliability of production services: observability, alerting, safe rollouts, incident response

 - Build internal tooling for investigation, enforcement, and auditability

 - Partner with fraud analysts to turn new abuse patterns into production detections quickly

Qualifications

 - 5+ years building and operating high-throughput, latency-sensitive backend systems in production

 - Strong systems programming skills; Rust, Go, or C++ experience preferred (we write Rust)

 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Terraform and cloud infrastructure

 - Solid data fundamentals: stream/batch computations, caching and storage trade-offs

 - Pragmatic, ownership-driven approach: ship incrementally, measure, and make failures degrade safely

Nice to have

 - Fraud prevention, anti-abuse, or payments-risk domain experience

 - Experience serving ML models in production

 - Client-side experience (web or mobile) for signal collection

wttj:3809a615-2f21-4155-992e-6d1e2ed60d2.desc:
Notre activité est en très forte croissance. Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous créons l’équipe Platform & Transformation , avec deux ambitions complémentaires :
 Platform : construire et maintenir une couche data (pipeline ETL) et des outils modernes, robustes et fiables (CRM, ERP, CMS).
 Transformation : comprendre les opérations des équipes métier, construire avec elles des solutions qui améliorent leur quotidien, puis leur en transférer l’ownership.
 Notre manière de travailler : des fondations robustes, du focus et des livraisons rapides qui créent un impact mesurable .
 Ton métier […]  comprendre comment nos équipes travaillent, et en faire des outils, des automations et des agents IA qu’elles s’approprient. 
 Ta mission
 Tu transformes le contexte métier en systèmes fiables et utiles. 
 Tu t’intègres à une équipe (ADV, Supply, Logistique, Growth…) et tu comprends comment elle travaille vraiment : ses process, ses règles, ses exceptions et tout le savoir tacite qui n’est documenté nulle part.
 Tu identifies ce qui peut être simplifié, amélioré ou automatisé, puis tu construis les solutions adaptées : automations, agents IA, apps internes, outils d’aide à la décision…
 Tu es un builder autonome techniquement, avec une forte sensibilité métier . Tu ne te contentes ni de recueillir des besoins, ni d’exécuter des demandes : tu challenges les problèmes, proposes des solutions et les construis toi-même.
 Ton objectif n’est pas de devenir indispensable aux équipes. C’est de leur permettre de travailler mieux, durablement, et avec un maximum d’autonomie.
 Ta réussite se mesure à l’impact créé et à l’autonomie des équipes après ton passage .
 Ce que tu feras
 Tu travailles par cycles courts, en immersion dans une équipe métier, en suivant cinq étapes :

Bakgrund Verifiering av digitala styrsystem i moderna flygplan bygger till stor del på omfattande simuleringar där flygegenskaper och systembeteenden utvärderas under olika förhållanden. För stridsflygplan ställs dessutom höga krav på att styrsystemet ska vara "care-free", vilket innebär att piloten ska kunna genomföra relevanta manövrar utan att riskera att hamna i ett farligt tillstånd. För att verifiera dessa egenskaper används idag ett stort antal fördefinierade manövrar som syftar till att utmana styrsystemet under olika förhållanden. Trots detta kan det fortfarande finnas kombinationer av manövrar, flygtillstånd och lastkonfigurationer som leder till mer kritiska utfall. Utmaningen blir särskilt relevant för framtida stridsflygsystem där nya koncept och användningsfall kan innebära helt andra dimensionerande manövrar än idag. Verifieringsutmaningen kan därför formuleras som ett sökproblem där målet är att identifiera dessa worst-case-fall. I dagsläget är verifierings- och klareringsprocessen både tidskrävande och resursintensiv, eftersom ett mycket stort antal scenarier behöver analyseras och utvärderas. Att identifiera kritiska testfall på ett mer automatiserat sätt är därför en viktig utmaning inom flygindustrin. Elk model heeft andere sterktes, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van codegeneratie, uitleg of redeneervermogen. De opdracht Onderzoek hoe een lokaal systeem ontwikkelaars kan ondersteunen bij het vergelijken van meerdere open source LLM-agents. Bouw een Proof of Concept waarin een ontwikkelaar één opdracht invoert, waarna het systeem deze opdracht lokaal doorstuurt naar verschillende modellen. Vergelijk de antwoorden op criteria zoals correctheid, volledigheid, snelheid, uitlegbaarheid en bruikbaarheid. Onderzoek ook de beperkingen van lokale modellen, zoals hardwarevereisten, responstijd en modelgrootte. Het resultaat is een werkende Proof of Concept met een onderbouwde vergelijking van meerdere open source LLM’s. linkedin:4444598425.desc: Het handmatig invullen van pensioenformulieren is niet alleen foutgevoelig, maar ook inefficiënt. In deze opdracht ga je een mobiele app ontwikkelen die gegevens uit documenten automatisch scant en invoert met behulp van multimodale AI. Je werkt een Proof of Concept uit waarin je de functionaliteit van de app en de bescherming van persoonsgegevens demonstreert. Hierbij leg je de nadruk op het ontwikkelen van een gebruiksvriendelijke en privacy vriendelijke oplossing. Deze afstudeeropdracht maakt onderdeel uit van het project ‘Van GRIJSpensioen naar GROENpensioen’. Met dit project geven we de […] ensioenwereld een digitale boost door het optimaliseren van digitale infrastructuren en processen. Zo maken we pensioenfondsen efficiënter en duurzamer, met beter datamanagement, sterke privacybescherming en gepersonaliseerde dienstverlening. Het handmatig overnemen van gegevens uit identiteitsdocumenten, werkgeversverklaringen en financiële overzichten naar pensioenformulieren is niet alleen monotoon en saai, maar ook foutgevoelig en inefficiënt. Fouten kunnen leiden tot onjuiste pensioenopbouw en -uitkeringen, met mogelijk aanzienlijke financiële gevolgen voor de betrokkenen. Daarnaast is het essentieel om de privacy van pensioengegevens te waarborgen, aangezien deze gevoelige financiële en persoonlijke informatie bevatten die beschermd moet worden tegen ongeautoriseerde toegang en datalekken. De opdracht Ontwikkel een mobiele applicatie die gebruikmaakt van multimodale AI om het invullen van pensioenformulieren te automatiseren. Dit doe je door documenten te scannen met de camera van een smartphone en de relevante informatie automatisch in het formulier te plaatsen. De applicatie moet zowel gebruiksvriendelijk als privacy vriendelijk zijn, met een sterke focus op de beveiliging van persoonsgegevens. Jouw taak is om een Proof of Concept te ontwikkelen dat niet alleen de functionaliteit demonstreert, maar ook hoe de applicatie de privacy van de gebruiker waarborgt. Over Info …

wttj:a376c857-e988-43e4-9534-abf4c08ad02.desc:
Applied AI Engineer - Direct Acquisition
 We're planning this as a six-month secondment. There may be an opportunity to extend it or make it permanent.
 We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join the Direct Acquisition team. 
 You'll design and build AI agents that run whole business processes, from planning the work to learning from the results. What you find will steer how far iwoca takes agents across the business.
 The company 
 Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance […] requirements 
 We're looking for the depth of someone who has solved hard problems, and the pace of someone who moves fast in areas that are new to them.
 Essential:
 System ownership. You've owned a complex system end to end, from design to running it in production, and lived with the consequences of your architecture choices. 
 Design judgement. You've made architecture decisions other people built on, and you can explain the trade-offs and what you'd change. When an idea won't work, you say so and offer a better one.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.



🛠️ About our Data Enrichment Teams

Our Data Enrichment team builds the ground-truth datasets and classifiers that describe complex driving scenes across Wayve's data corpus. Drawing on Wayve's World Foundation Model, we help teams find rare scenarios, expose […] requirements and measurable acceptance criteria for annotations and classifiers

• Design and refine annotation tasks and labelling instructions, using pilots, annotator agreement and expert review to resolve ambiguity and measure quality

• Curate and deliver ground-truth datasets for other teams to train and evaluate models, addressing rare scenarios, class imbalance and coverage across countries and vehicle platforms

• Build and evaluate computer vision models that draw on Wayve's World Foundation Model to identify scene attributes and driving behaviours

• Use error analysis to identify gaps in data, labels and model performance, and test approaches to improve them

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

• Ground-truth datasets and classifiers that describe road geometry, spatial relationships, road users and driving behaviour

• Integrating classifiers with enrichment infrastructure to run inference across existing and newly collected driving data, making predictions available for corpus analysis and scenario mining

• Improving reusable tools for annotation, training, evaluation and inference

• Documenting dataset and classifier quality, and communicating limitations to colleagues across disciplines

indeed:8124132cd6221fa0.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new […] we expect to run more AI agents than we have employees . Agents already do real work at Alan. They answer members' health questions, resolve support requests, read medical documents, detect fraud, automate operational tasks, and write a large share of our code. But every team building an agent ends up solving the same hard problems again: how to call models safely with health data, how to give an agent tools and the right permissions, how to know whether a prompt change made it better or worse, how to debug what it did. The result: several agent frameworks and evaluation stacks, each with its own security and compliance story. The Agentic Platform area was created to fix that. Our mission: make it cheap, fast and safe for every Alaner or crew to build, run and improve agentic products and workflows. We own the environment agents run in (infrastructure, runtime, evaluation, observability, skills lifecycle), with security, privacy and compliance by design, and the generalist products on top: Hopper and the Agent Studio. Product teams and all Alaners own their agents, skills, and their outcomes. We give them the paved road. Two crews, one team: Hopper is every Alaner's AI companion. Description
 🚀 Le Bureau des Talents est spécialisé dans la chasse, l’accompagnement et le coaching des talents pour les startups, les scale-ups et les entreprises à impact.
 Notre client est une startup française spécialisée en cybersécurité , qui développe une plateforme logicielle intégrant des technologies d'intelligence artificielle.
 En pleine phase de développement, elle s'attaque à des problématiques techniques complexes, au croisement de l'IA appliquée, du développement logiciel et de la sécurité informatique.
 Vous rejoindrez une équipe d'ingénieurs aux expertises complémentaires, […] ns un environnement entrepreneurial où l'exigence technique, l'autonomie et la prise d'initiative sont essentielles.
 L'occasion de contribuer à la construction de systèmes IA ambitieux et d'avoir un impact direct sur le produit et ses fondations techniques.
 Le poste

linkedin:4476304496.desc: Introduction Thesis work is an excellent way to get closer to Scania and build relationships for the future. Many of today's employees began their Scania career with their degree project. Background Scania develops advanced powertrain and exhaust aftertreatment systems to achieve high efficiency and low emissions across a wide range of operating conditions. Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) control requires accurate dosing decisions, robust emission prediction and effective use of signals available in the vehicle control system. Objective The objective of this master thesis is to develop […]  evaluate a methodology for AI-based, closed-loop SCR control. The controller shall use machine learning to determine dosing and support emission control over a representative operating cycle. The work will use measured test data and additional data generated in a Software-in-the-Loop (SiL) environment. Inputs may include engine operating point, load, speed, temperatures, flow conditions and other control-system variables. The AI model will be benchmarked against an existing reference SCR model in SiL using a virtual truck powertrain named VTAB (Virtual Truck and Bus). The project will establish a traceable workflow for data preparation, model training, validation and control integration. It will assess whether a data-driven model can reduce calibration effort and enable adaptable control while maintaining robust dosing and emission performance in a real powertrain. The Meta Reality Labs Research Team brings together a world-class team of researchers, developers, and engineers to create the future of virtual and augmented reality, which together will become as universal and essential as smartphones and personal computers are today. And just as personal computers have done over the past 45 years, AR, VR and MR will ultimately change everything about how we work, play, and connect. We are developing all the technologies needed to enable breakthrough AR glasses and VR headsets, including optics and displays, computer vision, audio, graphics, brain-computer […] nterfaces, haptic interaction, eye/hand/face/body tracking, perception science, and true telepresence. Some of those will advance much faster than others, but they all need to happen to enable AR, VR and MR that are so compelling that they become an integral part of our lives.
In particular, the Meta Reality Labs Research audio team is focused on two goals; creating virtual sounds that are perceptually indistinguishable from reality, and redefining human hearing. See more about our work here: Inside Facebook Reality Labs Research: The future of audio and Filter Out the Noise With Conversation Focus. These two initiatives will allow us to connect people by allowing them to feel together despite being physically apart, and allow them to converse in even the most difficult listening environments.
Meta Reality Labs Research is looking for an intern who is passionate about speech perception and audio quality to investigate why processed speech sometimes sounds degraded or robotic. The project focuses on identifying systematic phonemic errors as causal factors in perceived quality degradation, and linking these errors to human quality and intelligibility judgments. A core method is to explore the capabilities of audio vs video LLMs. This is fundamentally a speech-perception research role; multimodal/LLM methods are a supporting tool rather than the central focus.

 Developing compute kernels: Implement and improve operations such as matrix multiplication (GEMM), convolutions, reductions, elementwise operations and fused kernels that combine multiple operations. 
 Understanding and improving performance: Use profiling and microbenchmarks to measure execution speed and investigate how threading, cache locality, memory layout and kernel launch efficiency affect performance. 
 Checking correctness and reliability: Build regression tests and numerical checks, investigate issues and improve the quality of the libraries our customers use. 
 Through these projects, you’ll develop practical experience connecting numerical computing with how code runs on hardware, helping deliver software that is fast, accurate and reliable.

 You’ll join a team building high-performance compute libraries that help customers get more from Graphcore hardware. Our work brings together machine learning, numerical computing and accelerator performance, with colleagues sharing their expertise to solve engineering problems.

airbus:ATR---Internship-2027---Impact-of.desc:

 Want to join the ATR adventure? An internship opportunity has just opened on our site in Blagnac 
 In 2025, ATR has been awarded the Happy Trainees label. 94.3% of students recommend our company after their work-study or internship.

 Detailed description of the mission 
 The flight physics “Aircraft […] skills and experience within a market leading company! 
 Detailed description of the mission 
 The flight physics “Aircraft performance and weight” department is in charge of, among other things, the generation of performance data (low and high speed) for all ATR aircrafts.
 In the context of the TOPAAS project (Take-Off Performance Awareness and Alerting System), ATR is developing a system to reinforce take-off operations safety. This work is done in the frame of the future EASA regulation about take-off performance events prevention and implementation of TOPMS (Take-Off Performance Monitoring System)-like functionalities. 
 This internship objective is to analyze the impact of the main input errors on take-off performance and to deduce an algorithm able to anticipate these errors. 
 The internship will take place in 2 big steps: 
 1. Study of input errors impacts on take-off performance 
 At first, the intern will perform an analysis of the different events considered in EASA’s TOPMS to evaluate their impact on aircraft performance for ATR aircrafts. 
 This activity will include non-exhaustively: 
 The comprehension of the regulatory and operational context of the TOPMS events, 
 The identification of the different input errors which can affect take-off performance (weight, atmospheric conditions, etc.), 
 The evaluation of these errors impact on take-off distances for key …

Perplexity is looking for a Search Machine Learning Engineer Intern to help build the next generation of advanced search technologies, with a focus on retrieval and ranking. You will work closely with experienced engineers to improve search quality, experiment with new models, and ship features that directly impact how users search and discover information.

Internship program: 12 - 24 weeks, full-time, in-person in the London office.

Responsibilities:

 - Contribute to experiments that improve search quality through better models, data usage, and evaluation tools, under the guidance of senior engineers.

 - Design and implement components of the search platform and model stack, including retrieval, ranking, and classification models.

 - Train evaluating models (including LLM-based approaches) for retrieval, ranking, and classification tasks.

 - Support deployment and monitoring of search and ranking models in a scalable and performant way.

 - Help build and iterate on RAG pipelines for grounding and answer generation.

 - Collaborate with Data, AI, Infrastructure and Product teams to deliver improvements quickly and learn best practices in production ML.

Qualifications:

 - Strong foundation in machine learning and statistics, with coursework or projects related to information retrieval, ranking, or recommender systems.

 - Experience with Python and common ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) through academic, open source, or personal projects.

 - Familiarity with evaluating model quality using offline metrics and/or A/B testing is a plus, but not required.

 - Previous experience (internships, research, or significant projects) working on search, recommendation, or NLP is a plus, but not required.

 - Self-driven and curious, with a strong sense of ownership, willingness to learn, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment

 - Experience with Rust will be a plus

nxp:Intern-AI-and-Software-Engineer---Au.desc:
NXP Semiconductors, Automotive Processors, Solutions & Applications, Glasgow, UK, (3 month Summer Internship) 
 The mission:
 The car is becoming a computer on wheels, and AI is moving from the cloud to the edge; right onto silicon. Our S32N automotive MPUs pack proprietary AI IP blocks that let carmakers run machine learning where it matters: in the vehicle, in real-time, safely.
 We're looking for an AI-native intern — someone who reaches for an LLM, a notebook, or a model as second nature — to spend time with our Glasgow team working on real edge-AI problems with real automotive silicon.
 What you'll actually do:
 Get hands-on with our S32N MPUs — helping prepare, optimise and deploy ML models onto real hardware.
 Prototype AI use-cases and help turn them into demos.
 Write clean, modern code and use AI coding assistants and automation as everyday tools.
 Learn alongside a global network of experienced engineers who'll help you grow fast.
 What we're looking for:
 A 3rd or 4th year student working towards a degree in Computer Science, Electronics, AI/ML, Software or a related field.
 Familiarity with AI/ML basics and Python — and genuine curiosity about LLMs and modern AI workflows.
 Some software fundamentals (any C/C++ a bonus) and comfort with version control (git).
 A builder's mindset: you like learning by doing and aren't afraid of a problem without a textbook answer.
 Clear communication and enthusiasm to jump in.
 Why it's worth it:
 You'll get real experience at the ground floor of edge AI in automotive — real silicon, real problems, and a team that'll back you to experiment, learn, and bring us fresh thinking we don't yet have.
 More information about NXP in the United Kingdom...

They reproduce DFT at a fraction of its cost and have become a standard tool to simulate […] we expect from you? Review the literature on interatomic potentials, the computation of elastic constants and ultrasonic scattering. Build a small family of potentials from DFT data provided by the team: MACE-MP-0, versions of it fine-tuned on aluminium, and potentials trained from scratch, each with several seeds. Compute the elastic constants of aluminium at 0 K with each potential, and compare them with DFT. Compute the constants at room temperature with molecular dynamics, and compare them with experimental values. Estimate the mean and the full covariance of (C11, C12, C44) across potentials, and from it an error bar on ΔC. Correlated errors partly cancel in ΔC, so three separate error bars are not enough. Compare the spread between potentials with the error of DFT itself with respect to experiment. To go further With the CIVA team, propagate these constants and their error bars to the simulated ultrasonic attenuation. Then compare their effect with that of the uncertainty on grain size. Which uncertainty dominates for aluminium? How accurate should a potential be to be useful for NDT? Working environment The intern will work closely with a PhD student of the team who works on the training and uncertainty quantification of MLIPs. La Direction des Risques et du Contrôle Permanent (RPC) maîtrise et contrôle l’ensemble des risques du groupe Crédit Agricole CIB: risques individuels (ou risques de contrepartie), risques de marché, risques pays ou de portefeuille, risques opérationnels. Elle exerce ses missions dans le cadre de la ligne métier Risques du Groupe Crédit Agricole.
 VRM est le département de RPC responsable de la validation des modèles de mesure des risques de marché et de gestion […] cière, et de la surveillance des risques de modèles. Il est constitué d’analystes quantitatifs en charge de challenger les méthodologies et leur implémentation, et de mettre en place des processus et des outils de surveillance des risques de modèles. 
 Concrètement vos missions seront les suivantes : 
Dans le cadre de l’automatisation partielle de la documentation des validations de modèle, nous souhaitons développer un outil utilisant l’IA générative. Il faudra donc développer “from scratch” un agent autonome dans le cadre d’une Risk Team au sein de la banque.
Les Large Language Models (LLMs) , entraînés pour effectuer une modélisation causale du langage, peuvent s’attaquer à un large éventail de tâches, mais ils ont souvent du mal avec les tâches de base comme la logique, le calcul et la recherche. Lorsqu’on les invite à entrer dans des domaines dans lesquels ils ne sont pas performants, ils ne parviennent souvent pas à générer la réponse que nous attendons d’eux.
Une approche pour surmonter cette faiblesse est de créer un agent . Un agent est un système qui utilise un LLM comme moteur et qui a accès à des fonctions appelées outils
L’organisation du stage sera composée de différentes phases :
 Revue de la littérature existante ;
 Construction de l’agent : définition du type et du périmètre souhaité ;
 Proposition de moyens pour l’implémenter dans le pipeline existant au sein …

wttj:1bb93959-3832-46a5-b3d1-762a218ba79.title: STAGE - Deep Learning - Rehaussement de la parole pour lunettes auditives H/F
wttj:1bb93959-3832-46a5-b3d1-762a218ba79.desc:
Votre rôle : 
 Basée à Sophia Antipolis (France), Pulse Audition est une jeune start-up au sein d'EssilorLuxottica. L'équipe est composée d'experts en intelligence artificielle, en traitement du signal audio, en audiologie, en systèmes embarqués et en développement logiciel qui travaillent ensemble pour développer des technologies de pointe destinées à être intégrées dans des lunettes intelligentes, afin d'améliorer l'inclusion sociale des personnes souffrant de troubles auditifs. 
 Dans le cadre d'un partenariat de recherche avec le laboratoire de Mécanique des Structures et des Systèmes […] lés (LMSSC) du Cnam, l'objectif de ce stage est de renforcer les performances et la robustesse de nos modèles de rehaussement de la parole en exploitant des données enregistrées directement sur nos lunettes intelligentes dans des environnements acoustiques reproduits en laboratoire avec un spatialisateur ambisonique. Il est ainsi possible de recréer de manière contrôlée des scènes sonores réalistes et de capturer les signaux effectivement perçus par le dispositif. Ces données constituent une opportunité unique pour réduire l'écart entre les données d'entraînement et les conditions réelles d'utilisation, un enjeu majeur pour nos algorithmes d'intelligence artificielle.
 Le stage portera sur l'analyse et l'exploitation de ces nouvelles données afin d'améliorer nos modèles de rehaussement de la parole, en explorant à la fois des approches supervisées et semi-supervisées.
 Vos missions: 
 Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des pipelines de traitement et de qualification des données collectées afin de garantir leur qualité, leur diversité et leur pertinence pour l'entraînement de modèles d'IA.
 Analyser l'impact du changement de domaine sur les performances de notre modèle de réhaussement de la parole en comparant les performances du modèle sur les bases de données simulées et sur les signaux enregistrés directement sur le produit.
 Développer des stratégies d'entraînement supervisées et …

linkedin:4484233397.desc: Data Scientist at Fidorn London | On-site Fidorn builds AI-powered software for accounting firms. We're working directly with firms to understand how they operate, analyse their workflows and develop technology that automates repetitive work. We're hiring a data scientist who can work with complex, real-world data and turn it into practical solutions. You'll work closely with our engineering team, using operational data to identify opportunities, develop models and improve the performance of our products. The work You'll analyse large volumes of operational and workflow data to understand how accounting firms work, identify inefficiencies and quantify opportunities for automation. You'll develop and evaluate machine learning models, work with LLM-based systems and design experiments to measure their accuracy, reliability and effectiveness. The role involves working with messy datasets, building data pipelines, testing hypotheses and translating findings into improvements that can be deployed in production. Who we're looking for We're interested in people with strong mathematical and statistical foundations, excellent analytical skills and the ability to solve difficult problems independently. Experience with Python, SQL, machine learning, statistical modelling or LLM evaluation is particularly relevant. You should be comfortable working with real-world datasets and communicating your findings clearly to engineers and non-technical colleagues. We're open to students, recent graduates and experienced data scientists. What matters is technical ability, intellectual curiosity and evidence that you can turn analysis into useful outcomes. Applying Apply with your CV and, where possible, a GitHub profile, research paper or examples of relevant projects. We're particularly interested in seeing how you've approached challenging analytical problems, evaluated your methods and translated your findings into practical results.

À titre d'exemple, les cibles matérielles envisagées incluent des cartes telles que l'Alif Ensemble E7 [5] et la Texas Instruments TDA4VH [6]. linkedin:4483626223.title: Internship AI-simulated metals: from atoms to ultrasound-Saclay-H/F
linkedin:4483626223.desc: Context Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are trained on quantum-mechanical (DFT) calculations. They reproduce DFT at a fraction of its cost and have become a standard tool to simulate materials. Our team studies how to train these potentials and how to quantify their uncertainty. Different potentials make different predictions, and so does the same potential trained with different random seeds. Universal “foundation” potentials such as MACE-MP-0, for instance, are known to be too soft. The question Do these differences matter for a real application? We consider the ultrasonic […] we expect from you? Review the literature on interatomic potentials, the computation of elastic constants and ultrasonic scattering. Build a small family of potentials from DFT data provided by the team: MACE-MP-0, versions of it fine-tuned on aluminium, and potentials trained from scratch, each with several seeds. Compute the elastic constants of aluminium at 0 K with each potential, and compare them with DFT. Compute the constants at room temperature with molecular dynamics, and compare them with experimental values. Estimate the mean and the full covariance of (C11, C12, C44) across potentials, and from it an error bar on ΔC. Correlated errors partly cancel in ΔC, so three separate error bars are not enough. Compare the spread between potentials with the error of DFT itself with respect to experiment. To go further With the CIVA team, propagate these constants and their error bars to the simulated ultrasonic attenuation. Then compare their effect with that of the uncertainty on grain size. Which uncertainty dominates for aluminium? How accurate should a potential be to be useful for NDT? Working environment The intern will work closely with a PhD student of the team who works on the training and uncertainty quantification of MLIPs. The working language is English. # Cea-List Moyens / Méthodes / Logiciels Python, PyTorch, MACE, ASE, molecular dynamics, stochastic simulation, …

linkedin:4474281454.desc: La simulation des grandes échelles (Large Eddy Simulation, LES) constitue une approche largement utilisée pour la simulation des écoulements turbulents. Elle consiste à résoudre explicitement les grandes structures de l’écoulement tout en évaluant l’effet des petites échelles par un modèle dit sous-maille. La simulation des régions de l’écoulement situées près des parois demeure toutefois particulièrement coûteuse en raison des fortes contraintes de résolution spatiale du maillage dans ces régions. L’utilisation de modèles de paroi permet de relâcher ces contraintes et ainsi de diminuer […] icativement le coût numérique des simulations. La principale difficulté réside néanmoins dans la capacité de ces modèles à conserver leur robustesse et leur représentativité pour une large gamme de configurations et de régimes d’écoulement. Ce stage vise à explorer l’application des techniques de d’apprentissage machine (Machine Learning, ML) aux modèles de paroi utilisés dans les simulations des grandes échelles. Il s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une étude plus large consacrée au développement de modèles de fermeture LES basés sur l’apprentissage machine, avec pour objectif d’améliorer la précision des simulations tout en conservant un coût de calcul raisonnable. Les travaux menés au cours du stage seront réalisés en étroite collaboration avec ceux de la thèse actuellement en cours sur cette thématique. L’objectif principal du stage sera de concevoir et d’entraîner un modèle de paroi à partir de données issues de simulations numériques directes (Direct Numerical Simulations, DNS) d’écoulements de référence, notamment un écoulement en canal plan et un écoulement sur marche descendante. Southampton's School of Mathematical Sciences is home to a large research group in gravitational physics, currently comprising 7 staff members and a number of postdocs and PhD students. Members of the group are actively involved with the LIGO Scientific Collaboration, the Einstein Telescope Collaboration and the LISA Consortium. The ideal candidate will have a track record in numerical relativity and ideally some understanding of neutron star modelling, gravitational-wave astronomy and data analysis. Applicants will have, or be about to obtain, a relevant PhD degree in physics or mathematics. This is a fixed term post until 30th September 2027. A complete application should include (i) a CV, including a list of publications, and (ii) a statement of research interests (no more than 1 page). Informal enquiries may be made to Prof. Ian Hawke at I.Hawke@soton.ac.uk.

At the SDSC, we are dedicated to promoting a good and inclusive work environment that fosters happiness, health, and well-being among its employees. We believe in assembling an inclusive team of people who share our values and beliefs, and we recognize that a diverse workforce with people from all backgrounds, experiences, and opinions is critical to our success. We live in an international context where gender equality is valued, ensuring everyone has similar chances and is equally appreciated for their efforts.
Our recruitment policy is based on the following principles:

1. Fair practices : SDSC upholds transparent and fair hiring practices, treating all candidates with dignity, respect, and equality. We have clear and comprehensible guidelines that guide our recruitment methods and ensure every employee understands and follows them.

2. Positive culture : SDSC is committed to creating a work environment prioritizing its workers' well-being, satisfaction, and productivity. We support flexible working arrangements, including remote work possibilities, and provide a safe and healthy work environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and supported.

3. Gender equality: We value gender equality and give equal opportunity and respect to all employees. We think everyone has unique talents and skills and encourage all our employees, regardless of gender, to attain their full potential. We establish an environment where gender stereotypes (and all other biases) are challenged, resulting in an inclusive and empowering workplace.

4. Cultural diversity : We believe in the potential of inclusion and diversity. We seek to assemble a group of enthusiastic individuals who share our beliefs and ideals regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual identity, religion, or handicap. We actively recruit people with varied origins, nationalities, and experiences because we believe that a diverse workforce promotes innovation, creativity, and effective problem-solving.

5. Continuous growth : SDSC is committed to promoting our workers' ongoing education and development. We provide opportunities for professional development, allowing individuals to improve their skills, knowledge, and talents. We encourage our employees to realize their professional goals by offering resources and support.

indeed:4b9e6d1705615312.title: PhD fellowship in climate and health epidemiology
indeed:4b9e6d1705615312.desc: PhD fellowship in climate and health epidemiology A 3-year PhD fellowship is available at the Work, Environment and Cancer group at the Danish Cancer Institute. The position We are seeking a PhD student to work on a large EU-funded consortium project, Understanding and Preventing Climate-Related Health Risks through Mediating Pathways (U-PATH) . Europe is the fastest-warming continent, yet evidence that separates direct heat effects from effects mediated by other environmental exposures, such as air pollution, aeroallergens, noise, and indoor overheating, is still lacking. U-PATH brings together 15 international research institutions to investigate how climate exposures relate to cardiovascular and respiratory disease, with a particular focus on the mediating role of environmental exposures. The Work, Environment and Cancer group’s main tasks in U-PATH include: coordinating the harmonization of epidemiological data from cohorts in five countries contributing data and analyses from a Danish nationwide cohort conducting measurement campaigns of indoor summer temperatures, which will be used to develop a model for indoor heat exposure assessment coordinating analyses of associations between long-term residential indoor and outdoor heat events and risk of cardiovascular and respiratory disease across the cohorts The Work, Environment and Cancer research group is a dynamic multi-national team of researchers dedicated to studying the effects of environmental and occupational exposures on the development of cancer and other diseases. Your main responsibilities Conduct indoor temperature measurement campaigns Contribute to developing a model for indoor exposure assessment Link climate exposure data to Danish residential addresses Generate analysis-ready datasets with climate and environmental exposures, health outcomes, and potential confounders for the Danish population Analyze associations between climate and environmental exposures and risk of cardiovascular and respiratory disease, in collaboration with key U-PATH partners Write scientific papers for international peer-reviewed journals Present results at U-PATH consortium meetings and international conferences PhD enrolment You will be enrolled as a PhD student at a Danish university and supervised by researchers from the Work, Environment and Cancer group. Enrolment is subject to approval by the relevant PhD school, and it is a prerequisite for receiving the stipend that you are enrolled as a PhD student. Your progress as a PhD student will be assessed at regular intervals. As part of your PhD studies, you will be required, among other things, to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS and to undertake a research stay of 3-6 months at a foreign research institution. Qualifications Required A master’s degree (completed or nearly completed) in public health, epidemiology, statistics, or related discipline Experience in statistical programming, preferably in SAS and/or R A systematic and well-organized work approach, with strong planning and collaboration skills Excellent written and spoken English An advantage Experience with statistical analyses in quantitative epidemiological research Experience with large datasets and register-based data Experience with GIS software, such as QGIS Experience with contributing to peer-reviewed publications Interest in or experience with field data collection We offer An inspiring and dynamic working environment in an interdisciplinary research center (biologists, human biologists, public health scientists, medical doctors, data managers, psychologists, statisticians, etc.) where we work with many different epidemiological and biological topics. The research department regularly hosts interdisciplinary seminars with external lecturers on biological and epidemiological research areas and internal courses on relevant topics. Also, we have a Postdoc network that arranges regular meetings and seminars. Salary, pension, and conditions of employment will be in accordance with the provisions of the collective agreement between the Danish government and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). We offer canteen, fruit scheme, sports- and art clubs as well as physiotherapy. You will initially be employed as research assistants to allow time for enrollment as PhD students at the University. You are expected to write your PhD application with support from your supervisor. The Danish Cancer Society of course has a no smoking policy during working hours. Start date: The position is a 3-year full-time position and is open from January 1st 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. More information For specific information about the project or the position, please contact Group Leader and Professor Mette Sørensen, mettes@cancer.dk, +45 3525 7626 Application and deadline Submit your application no later than 15th of November 2026 . Applications submitted after this date will not be considered. We only accept applications through our electronic system at www.cancer.dk/job. The application must include: A cover letter (maximum two pages) describing how your qualifications match the project A detailed CV A Master's degree diploma, or documentation of expected completion A list of publications, if any, including submitted manuscripts Application due 11/15/2026 Start date 1/1/2027 Work hours Position category Position type Workplace Copenhagen Homepage https://www.cancer.dk Contact Mette Sørensen Gruppeleder 35257626 More vacant positions Follow us

indeed:1487285dffc45afd.title: PHD POSITION IN URBAN SOCIAL RESILIENCE WITHIN SUSTAINABILITY AND PLANNING
indeed:1487285dffc45afd.desc: Description of the Position Aalborg University invites applications for a PhD position in Sustainability and Planning Research focusing on urban resilience from a systemic and planning-oriented perspective. The PhD project explores the dynamic relationships between people, places, and material environments and is situated within an emerging research agenda investigating how design thinking and planning practices can support circularity and sustainability initiatives in cities. This PhD position, funded by the project “Co-creating regenerative green-social infrastructures for urban circular economies” ( WeGrowCircle ) through the Driving Urban Transitions Partnership, is part of a new interdisciplinary thematic research initiative addressing Urban Social Resilience (USR) with particular attention to care ethics, participatory processes, and social innovation as guiding perspectives. The successful candidate will contribute to interdisciplinary research activities, empirical studies, and scholarly publications in close collaboration with other members of the USR initiative across the Department of Sustainability & Planning and the Department of Architecture, Design & Media Technology. The position further offers engagement in a wider research network spanning urban sustainability, innovation, planning, design, and architecture. The position is available from 1 January 2027 or soon hereafter, and with employment in the Sustainability, Innovation and Policy research group. The duration of the position is three years. Research Focus The PhD project addresses the pressing challenge of developing urban social resilience in cities, with a particular focus on how social actors, relations, and practices can gain agency in resilience-building processes through inclusive, collaborative, participatory, and planning-based approaches across actors, organisations, and institutions. The project is grounded in a socio-material planning and design perspective, where urban resilience is understood as an emergent quality produced through interactions between social dynamics, institutional frameworks, and material and spatial configurations. Within this framework, the PhD project must in particular contribute to: establishing a shared conceptual and methodological foundation for the WeGrowCircle project, e.g. as a Resilient Urban Commons Framework mapping and analysing actor landscapes, relations, and key dynamics in the development of urban social resilience and regenerative green-social infrastructures (GSIs) developing and testing an inclusive co-creation process for GSI design, exploring stewardship and governance models for resilient and collective land management, evaluating how GSIs can improve biodiversity, circular practices, sufficiency, and social well-being; and generating evidence and recommendations for integrating GSIs into local planning, climate action and community practice. The PhD project may adopt different disciplinary perspectives, empirical focus areas, and methodological approaches within the broader field of urban social resilience and planning. At the same time, it is expected that the project will relate to and further develop the research environment’s work with socio-material approaches, participatory and interactive planning, as well as co-design and co-production in the context of urban resilience. Applicants are therefore expected to develop and outline a preliminary research proposal (1–3 pages) that presents their initial considerations regarding research focus, research design, and methodological approach in relation to urban social resilience within a planning and design perspective. Research Context The specific empirical context of the PhD project is closely linked to the WeGrowCircle project and thus mainly to the Aalborg Living Lab. However, engagement with one or more of the other three living labs (Brussels, Gothenburg, Bucharest) in the project is expected. Decision about which one(s) is intentionally left open at this point, and need not be considered in the application. Your Competences Applicants should demonstrate a strong interest in exploring how urban resilience is shaped through the interplay between social and material dimensions. The PhD project is expected to investigate planning and design processes with particular attention to participatory, co-design, and co-production approaches, as well as the use of mapping as an analytical and generative research method. Applicants must hold a Master’s degree in sustainability and planning, urban studies, sustainability and design, geography, or a related discipline. Experience with qualitative, participatory, and design-oriented research methods—including co-design or co-production—is considered a significant advantage. The ideal candidate is motivated to work in interdisciplinary research environments and is interested in collaborating across disciplines and with a wide range of urban stakeholders, including planners, designers, and public sector actors. The candidate should demonstrate curiosity, independence, and initiative, and be motivated to develop and conduct a PhD project involving co-design and co-production in close collaboration with supervisors and research partners. Qualification requirements PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Technical Doctoral School of IT and Design in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution. What we Offer The position offers a dynamic and interdisciplinary research environment rooted in contemporary sustainability and planning research. The PhD candidate will have the opportunity to contribute to and shape a growing body of research on design and planning for urban social resilience. The position includes support for scholarly publications and public communication of research, and carries an obligation for teaching, supervising, and involvement in the Department’s bachelor and master programmes on planning and sustainability. How to apply Your application must include the following: Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position Curriculum Vitae (CV) Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) A preliminary research proposal (1–3 pages) Other relevant documents The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions? You may obtain further information from Associate Professor Martin Lehmann martinl@plan.aau.dk concerning the scientific aspects of the stipend. For further information about stipends and salary as well as practical issues concerning the application procedure contact Lisbeth Diinhoff, The Doctoral School at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, email: ld@adm.aau.dk Further information Read more about our recruitment process here. The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts. Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not. The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. Read more about The Technical Doctoral School of IT and Design Salary and terms of employment The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”. There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position. Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen. indeed:92f55c01bb0b0b89.title: THESE EN INTELLIGENCE ARTIFICIELLE (H/F)
indeed:92f55c01bb0b0b89.desc: 35170 Bruz, Bretagne CDD A propos de Sogitec Venez faire décoller vos talents à nos côtés ! Société d’ingénierie en aéronautique, SOGITEC est leader dans la conception, le développement, la production et la fourniture de produits et services de simulation, pour la formation et l’entrainement au sol des pilotes et mécaniciens qui emploient et soutiennent les aéronefs réels. Filiale à 100% de Dassault Aviation, l’entreprise compte plus de 300 collaborateurs et s’impose comme un partenaire de premier niveau au service des constructeurs aéronautiques. Combinant sa longue expérience des exigences opérationnelles et ses compétences dans l’intégration des nouvelles technologies, telles que l’intelligence artificielle ou la réalité virtuelle, SOGITEC investit dans la recherche et l’innovation. Ainsi, SOGITEC intervient en tant que maître d'œuvre de programmes français et internationaux, complexes, pluriannuels et impliquant de multiples coopérations industrielles. SOGITEC s’appuie sur un socle d’affaires en forte consolidation grâce aux ventes du RAFALE et de ses moyens de simulation, dont il est le fournisseur exclusif. De plus, SOGITEC s’adapte aux besoins d’entraînement des Forces aériennes pour les derniers hélicoptères d’AIRBUS Helicopter par la fourniture des simulateurs de NH90 et prochainement du tout nouveau HIL (H160M). Enfin, SOGITEC développe de nouveaux produits de simulation dans les domaines des drones et des hélicoptères, y compris pour le personnel dédié à l’emploi du treuil et de l’armement. Ces succès reposent sur des équipes passionnées et dynamiques, d’un très haut niveau d’expertise technique, sur l’envie de repousser les limites et la capacité à faire face aux exigences d’une activité en constante évolution pour construire l’avenir. Votre mission THESE EN INTELLIGENCE ARTIFICIELLE : CONTRÔLE PAR INTELLIGENCE ARTIFICIELLE DES ENTITÉS VIRTUELLES D’UN SIMULATEUR DE VOL AFIN D’ATTEINDRE LES OBJECTIFS DE LEUR MISSION. A SOGITEC, VOUS SEREZ : Dans le cadre de ses activités de simulation d’avions d’armes et d’hélicoptères, SOGITEC souhaite renforcer sa capacité à modéliser et à simuler le comportement des forces en présence à partir de techniques d’intelligence artificielle. Les simulateurs développés par ses équipes s’appuient sur un serveur tactique pour animer les entités aériennes, terrestres et navales présentes sur le théâtre d’opérations virtuel. Pour un opérateur ou un moniteur simulation, paramétrer chacune de ces entités requiert un travail fastidieux pour obtenir le résultat souhaité en termes de déplacement ou réaction. Depuis plusieurs années, SOGITEC investigue des méthodes d’apprentissage machine afin d’envisager un contrôle plus intuitif des entités programmables. Les algorithmes employés ont jusqu’ici produit des résultats prometteurs mais l’entreprise souhaite poursuivre ses travaux de recherche afin d’identifier des solutions flexibles capables de gérer des situations plus complexes (grand nombre d’entités, diversité des missions/situations, etc). Dans ce contexte SOGITEC et ISAE-SUPAERO souhaitent travailler en collaboration, au travers d’une thèse CIFRE, pour lever les verrous technologiques correspondants :  Recenser les missions d’intérêt, identifier le meilleur moyen de modéliser ces missions et de les paramétrer par un utilisateur.  Identifier l’architecture algorithmique de contrôle des entités qui doit en résulter.  Statuer sur le niveau de contrôle.  Évaluer la scalabilité/portabilité de la solution. Votre profil AUJOURD’HUI VOUS ÊTES : Vous devez disposer d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou d’un diplôme universitaire de niveau Bac+5 avec un M2 recherche ou avec une expérience avérée de recherche (obligatoire). Cadre de travail : Vous serez rattaché(e) à la Direction des Simulations à SOGITEC, et serez sous la responsabilité de son chef de service. En tant que doctorant(e) spécialisé(e) dans l’IA, vous devez être en capacité d’imaginer de nouvelles solutions dans ce domaine, adaptées à nos problématiques. Vous serez également inscrit(e) à l’ISAE-SUPAERO, Université de Toulouse, qui sera votre laboratoire d’accueil doctoral. Vous serez rattaché(e) au département DCAS, sous la supervision de ses directeurs de thèse. Vous participerez également à des projets stratégiques intégrant (non exhaustif) le Deep Learning avancé, Apprentissage par Renforcement (RL) ou encore l’IA générative et modèles de langage (LLM), et serez en en étroite collaboration avec les équipes techniques et métiers afin de transformer les besoins fonctionnels en solutions algorithmiques performantes et industrialisables chez SOGITEC. Dans ce cadre, vous réaliserez des travaux d'études bibliographiques, d'études algorithmiques, de prototypage, de développement logiciel, de spécification logicielle, d'architecture et conception, de test des solutions (robustesse, performance, etc), de rédaction de publications (et participation à des conférences du domaine). Compétences scientifiques et techniques recherchées : Fondamentaux scientifiques (mathématique, statistique, probabilité, algèbre, optimisation numérique…) et techniques de développement logiciel (langages programmation C++, Python, algorithmie en général…) solides Deep Learning, réseaux de neurones, méthodes d’entrainement… Planification sous incertitude, Décision Séquentielle, Apprentissage par renforcement... IA Générative & LLM (Transformers, Prompt engineering, RAG, Fine-tuning, Agentique…) Industrialisation & MLOps (Hardware et Infrastructure, CI/CD, déploiement des modèles en production, Monitoring). Compétences relationnelles et non techniques recherchées : De curiosité scientifique et technique, pour le secteur défense en particulier. D’adaptation (au domaine de l’aéronautique et la simulation de vol, à la complexité du sujet, à la diversité des compétences requises). D’appétences pour les défis technologiques. De capacités d’abstraction du problème posé. De prise de recul et d’anticipation. D’autonomie et de proposition d’idées. D’aisance organisationnelle et relationnelle.

indeed:5e6713f9ef615246.title: PhD Position in EU Doctoral Network "PANDORA"
indeed:5e6713f9ef615246.desc: PhD Position in EU Doctoral Network "PANDORA" Réf ABG-140512 Sujet de Thèse 13/10/2026 Financement de l'Union européenne Sorbonne Université Lieu de travail Paris - Ile-de-France - France Intitulé du sujet PhD Position in EU Doctoral Network "PANDORA" Champs scientifiques Biologie Santé, médecine humaine, vétérinaire Mots clés Biological sciences, Biology, Medical sciences, Neurosciences, Immunology Description du sujet The position focuses on "Evaluating how complement dysregulation influences mononuclear phagocyte accumulation in AMD" within the MSCA Doctoral Network PANDORA (Discovering Pathomechanisms and Novel Drug Optimization for AMD). Subretinal mononuclear phagocytes (MPs) build up in the photoreceptor cell layer, a zone normally kept free of immune cells by the immunosuppressive retinal pigment epithelium (RPE). This build-up is a key driver of age-related macular degeneration (AMD). MPs include microglia and monocyte-derived inflammatory macrophages (MoMφ). Our team has shown that activated MPs evade RPE-mediated clearance. We have also shown that the AMD-linked CFH 402H variant impairs the removal of subretinal MPs independently of its role in the complement system. How complement dysregulation contributes to immune cell accumulation in the subretinal space in AMD remains poorly understood. The PhD student will first map where complement cascade components are found in the human retina. Using multiplexed immunohistochemistry on post-mortem retinal sections from AMD donors and age-matched controls, the student will localise components of the classical, lectin and alternative pathways, their activation products, regulators (CFH and Factor H-related proteins) and receptors. These components will be mapped relative to subretinal MPs, the RPE, photoreceptors and drusen. The student will then study how the Chromosome 1 (Chr1) AMD risk haplotype affects RPE, microglia and MoMφ and their interactions. They will use control and Chr1-risk iPSC-derived cells in a well-defined co-culture system developed in our laboratory. The student will also study the role of plasma-derived Factor H-related proteins (FHR1-5) using depleted human plasma and purified complement factors. Using single-cell and bulk RNA sequencing and proteomics, the student will analyse how complement dysregulation affects: microglia and MoMφ polarisation the interaction of these cells with the immunosuppressive RPE key inflammatory pathways and immune functions in the subretinal microenvironment, in health and in AMD Finally, the student will test whether complement inhibitors (anti-C5, anti-C3) can restore immune balance. The project is supervised by Dr. Florian Sennlaub (Institut de la Vision, Paris) It is carried out in close collaboration with other PANDORA doctoral candidates. Techniques and Training Include: Multiplexed immunohistochemistry on human donor retinal sections (AMD and age-matched controls), whole-slide/confocal imaging and quantitative image analysis Induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived RPE, microglia and macrophage models, and immune cell/RPE co-cultures Primary human monocyte isolation and differentiation, and work with human plasma and purified complement factors Single-cell and bulk transcriptomics, and proteomics Flow cytometry, qPCR, western blot, ELISA/multiplex cytokine assays Functional immune assays (phagocytosis, migration, survival/clearance) Prise de fonction : 01/02/2027 Nature du financement Financement de l'Union européenne Précisions sur le financement Horizon Europe – MSCA (Marie Curie Actions) Présentation établissement et labo d'accueil Sorbonne Université Founded by Professor José-Alain Sahel, the Institut de la Vision is an international research centre dedicated entirely to research into eye and vision diseases. It brings together researchers, doctors, patients and industry on the same site to discover innovative treatments for eye diseases and improve the quality of life of visually impaired people. It is being built on a site that brings together l’Hôpital national de la vision des 15-20 and its Clinical Investigation Centre (CIC), as well as the Centre for Rare Retinal Diseases. Designed as a place where people can come together and exchange ideas, the Institut de la Vision enables ideas to be shared, new questions to emerge and the transfer of research findings to patient care to be accelerated. Its innovative organisation, based around hospital patients, enables new therapeutic or technological solutions to be discovered, tested and developed in order to prevent eye diseases or limit their effects. More than 300 researchers are working in the 5 research departments of the Institut de la Vision: developmental biology of the visual system, genetics, visual information processing, pathophysiology and therapeutics, photonics. All the Institut de la Vision's activities and projects are coordinated by its Foundation (Foundation Institut de la vision), in conjunction with its three supervisory bodies: Sorbonne University, Inserm and the CNRS. Site web : http://www.institut-vision.org Profil du candidat Education Level: Master's Degree or equivalent in life sciences, biology, immunology, neurobiology or biomedical sciences Essential Skills/Qualifications: Solid knowledge of cellular and molecular biology and/or immunology Excellent written and oral English proficiency Strong motivation for research on retinal degeneration and neuroinflammation Ability to work both in a team and independently Preferred Qualifications: Hands-on experience in cell culture (ideally primary immune cells or iPSC-derived cells) and flow cytometry Experience with immunohistochemistry/immunofluorescence and image analysis Background in innate immunity, macrophage/microglia biology and the complement system Interest in, or basic experience with, omics data analysis Language: Excellent English (French not required) Applicants must meet these requirements: They must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in France for more than 12 months in the 36 months before the recruitment date.
